name: @neptune/engine
description: Neptune agent harness kernel. Houses the SDK wrapper, provider adapters, permissions, storage, hooks, EventBus, and CC runtime — i.e. the K + K-DEFAULT layer described in 2026-05-21 harness extraction spec. Retains a transitional reverse-dependency on @neptune/engine-product for unmigrated boundary-blur targets (Tool.ts, utils/*, types/*, services/*), to be cleared in spec phase 2.
